We are working exclusively with a well-known, European leading organisation on the lookout for a HR Assistant to join their team in Warwick. This is an incredible opportunity to join a great company within a fantastic team.

This role will be responsible for managing the administration for the whole employee life cycle, for all employees split over two business units. Providing a proactive and efficient HR administrative service that supports the overall objectives of the department. Acting as the point of contact for all first level HR issues, ensuring correct procedures are followed; documented where applicable and excellent service is provided to all stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:
- To be the first point of contact for all HR queries - providing guidance and support to managers and/or employees in line with company policies and procedures and statutory provisions
- Maintaining an efficient and effective new starter process from point of offer through to onboarding, ensuring that the set HR procedure is followed and all associated electronic and paper based information is inputted in a timely manner
- Maintain all updates on the HR management systems (SAP; Success Factors and Umantis) and all other internal HR systems)
- Ensuring a strong link is maintained between HR and Payroll and all associated documentation is submitted with accuracy and on time
- Providing a general administrative service for the HR department, including but not limited to:
- Generating letters, contracts and ensuring statutory process adherence
- Updating KPI information and generating ad hoc statistical reporting
- Respond to external and internal information requests
- Supporting projects and completion of HR objectives
- Assisting with the recruitment process, from applicant tracking through to assisting with first level assessments
- Processing invoices & monitoring departmental budgetary spend
- Conducting exit interviews
- General office duties such as the upkeep of personnel records and maintaining the H.R filing and archive system, standards forms and compliance with GDPR
- Provide support with the facilitation of training source and arrange course enrolment, gather information to produce training agreements and maintain records of training undertaken.
- Provide advice and guidance to managers, supporting on first level employee relations issues
- Managing and supporting the recruitment process including administration and first level assessment support
- Undertake projects as and when required in line with the objectives of the role

KEY REQUIREMENTS
- Previous administration experience in a fast-paced commercial business
- Dealing with confidential subject matter
- Experience working with SAP
- Knowledge and ability to offer first line HR advice in relation to current legislation
- Experience working with multiple stakeholders and competing deadlines
- Managed a high level of recruitment activity
- First level HR advice, e.g. performance issues, ER, coaching
- HR Degree (or equivalent HR qualification)
- Confidence to deal with people internally and externally at all levels
- Ability to use own initiative and learn quickly
- Ability to prioritise own work levels

By applying for this position, you authorise Auctoro Recruitment to hold your personal details on file for use in finding you a suitable position. Auctoro Recruitment will never transfer your information to a third party without your prior consent.

title: HR Assistant
company: HR Dept - South Warwickshire - Agency - Permanent
description:
This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive and friendly HR consultancy team based in Warwick, providing high-quality administrative support across a varied client base. The role would suit a highly organised, detail-focused administrator who enjoys working in a busy, people-focused environment and is keen to build a long-term career in HR. Previous HR experience would be beneficial but is not essential, as full support, training and exposure to a wide range of HR matters will be provided.

Why Join Us

You will be joining a collaborative team where no two days are the same, gaining hands-on experience across employee relations, recruitment administration, HR documentation, client systems and general HR support. The role offers the chance to learn from experienced HR professionals, attend meetings alongside HR Advisors and develop practical HR knowledge while contributing to meaningful work for clients.

Training and Progression: Training and support will be provided, with the opportunity to develop HR knowledge and progress within the role.

Job Purpose

The role of the job is to provide excellent administrative support to the HR Advice team, helping to deliver a responsive, accurate and professional service to clients while developing practical HR knowledge and experience.

Main Duties
- Drafting HR letters as directed by the team including, disciplinary invites, grievance invites, outcome letters, letters of concern, resignation letters, flexible working letters etc.
- Drafting contracts and offer letters.
- Providing an effective service for our clients.
- Attending meetings with a HR Advisor to develop knowledge and experience.
- Answering incoming calls, taking details and supporting the clients where able to or providing accurate messages to the team in a timely manner.
- Support recruitment campaigns for clients, including drafting job adverts, shortlisting candidates and arranging interviews
- Uploading advice to the CRM system
- Liaising with third party providers e.g. occupational health, DBS
- Supporting the team with administration in relation to clients HR systems
- Note taking during meetings and note typing of meetings and recordings
- Supporting the team with creation and updating of handbooks, policies and contacts for clients

Qualifications and Experience Required for This Role

We are particularly interested in hearing from strong administrators who are highly organised, accurate and keen to develop a career within HR. HR experience would be advantageous, but it is not essential for the right person.
- Outstanding business organisational skills
- HR experience would be advantageous but is not essential.
- Strong administrator
- Self-motivated, able to take initiative and use sound judgment in day-to-day decision making
- Customer-focused with a 'can do' attitude
- Ability to work to tight and often conflicting deadlines in a fast paced working environment
- Ability to work accurately, with meticulous attention to detail
- Able to work with complete discretion and confidentiality at all times
- Expertise of MS Office (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook)

title: HR Officer
description:
HR Officer
Location: Warwick
Salary: £38,000-£40,000 per annum, depending on experience
Contract: Three-month temp-to-perm, transferring to direct employment with our client following successful completion

Looking for a hands-on HR role where you can help shape how a growing business supports its people?
Recruitable Staffing Solutions is recruiting an experienced HR Officer for our client based in Warwick.
This varied generalist position combines day-to-day HR support with the opportunity to improve policies, processes and ways of working. You'll work closely with management, helping build fair, consistent and practical HR practices as the business grows.

The role
Your responsibilities will include:
- Coordinating recruitment, onboarding and leaver processes.
- Providing first-line HR support to employees and management.
- Reviewing existing HR practices, identifying gaps and recommending improvements.
- Drafting and updating HR policies and procedures for management approval.
- Maintaining accurate, confidential employee records.
- Managing absence and attendance records, checking routine timesheets and preparing payroll information for an external provider.
- Supporting HR planning, budgets and reporting.
- Implementing agreed HR initiatives and monitoring their progress.
- Escalating sensitive matters or significant decisions to management when appropriate.

About you
We're looking for someone with:
- Previous experience in a UK-based generalist HR or HR Officer role, ideally around three to five years.
- Practical knowledge of UK employment rights and day-to-day HR processes.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- A confident, approachable communication style.
- The ability to handle sensitive information professionally and confidentially.
- A proactive approach, with the judgement to recognise when management approval or specialist advice is needed.

You don't need experience in every responsibility listed. A strong grounding in generalist HR and the ability to take ownership of day-to-day processes are key.

What's on offer?
- £38,000-£40,000 annual salary, depending on experience.
- An initial three-month temporary assignment through Recruitable Staffing Solutions, with the intention of transferring to permanent employment directly with our client following successful completion.
- A varied role with scope to make a visible contribution.
- The opportunity to help develop HR processes within a growing business.

Apply with your up-to-date CV, outlining your relevant HR experience and availability.

title: PMO Coordinator & Document Controller
description:
Pontoon is an employment consultancy. We put expertise, energy, and enthusiasm into improving everyone's chance of being part of the workplace. We respect and appreciate people of all ethnicities, generations, religious beliefs, sexual orientations, gender identities, and more. We do this by showcasing their talents, skills, and unique experience in an inclusive environment that helps them thrive.

Job Title: PMO Coordinator & Document Controller

Location: Warwick / Hybrid

Contract Type: 6 months contract with scope to extend

Role Overview

This role sits within a major infrastructure transformation programme and is responsible for the control, governance, and secure handling of sensitive, confidential, and encrypted project documentation and information.

Working within a structured PMO and project controls environment, the Document Controller ensures that all programme information is correctly classified, securely managed, version-controlled, and fully auditable across the project lifecycle.

This role is critical to maintaining information integrity, compliance, and governance standards across all project documentation, including regulated and protectively marked materials.

Key Responsibilities

Secure Document Control & Governance
- Manage the full lifecycle of controlled and sensitive programme documentation
- Ensure all documents are correctly classified, versioned, and securely stored
- Maintain strict adherence to document control procedures for protectively marked / confidential information
- Control document distribution, access permissions, and encryption compliance
- Ensure traceability of all document changes and approvals

Information Management & PMO Support
- Maintain structured document repositories and controlled data environments (e.g. SharePoint / CDE platforms)
- Support PMO governance processes through accurate documentation control
- Maintain registers, logs, and information tracking systems (RAID, change logs, action trackers)
- Support audit readiness by ensuring all records are complete, consistent, and retrievable

Data Integrity & Quality Assurance
- Conduct routine quality checks on documentation and data records
- Identify and resolve inconsistencies in document versions, metadata, and classification
- Escalate data integrity or compliance risks to PMO leadership
- Support continuous improvement of document control processes

Secure Digital & BIM-Related Information Handling
- Coordinate secure submission, storage, and retrieval of digital project information
- Maintain controlled records relating to model/data submissions where applicable
- Track document/model status through review and approval workflows
- Ensure secure handling of digital outputs from design and engineering teams

(This is coordination and control-focused - not technical BIM production)

Stakeholder & Supplier Information Control
- Act as the primary point of contact for document control queries across project teams and suppliers
- Manage secure access requests and permissions for controlled systems
- Support onboarding/offboarding relating to information access rights
- Ensure external parties comply with programme information control standards

Skills & Experience

Essential
- Proven experience as a Document Controller in a project, programme, or infrastructure environment
- Strong understanding of secure document handling, confidentiality, and access control
- Experience working with controlled or sensitive information (e.g. protectively marked data)
- Strong knowledge of document management systems (SharePoint, Aconex, A-Site, or similar CDE platforms)
- High attention to detail and strong organisational discipline
- Experience maintaining version control, metadata standards, and audit trails

Desirable
- Experience in regulated sectors (utilities, defence, rail, energy, construction)
- Familiarity with ISO 19650 information management principles
- Exposure to BIM/digital engineering information workflows (administrative support only)
- Experience supporting audits or compliance reviews
- Experience handling encrypted or security-controlled documentation environments

Key Performance Indicators
- Accuracy and compliance of document classification and version control
- Timeliness of document processing and distribution
- Audit readiness of document repositories
- Reduction in document errors, duplication, or misclassification
- Compliance with secure information handling procedures

Apply now!

Please be advised: if you haven't heard from us within 48 hours, then unfortunately your application has not been successful on this occasion. We may, however, keep your details on file for any suitable future vacancies and contact you accordingly.

We use generative AI tools to support our candidate screening process. This helps us ensure a fair, consistent, and efficient experience for all applicants. Rest assured, all final decisions are made by our hiring team, and your application will be reviewed with care and attention.

title: Temporary Billing Administrator
description:
Billing Operations Administrator
Location: Warwick
Full Time-Temporary
Role Overview
We are looking for a detail-oriented Billing Operations Administrator to support the timely and accurate release of billing documents and ensure billing performance targets are met. The role plays a key part in delivering efficient billing operations by managing invoice distribution and monitoring billing timeliness through reporting. This position is at present, available until the end of December 2026 and would be a great opportunity for someone to gain strong commercial experience within an accounting team.

Key Responsibilities
Billing Document Management
- Release billing documents (invoices, credit notes) to customer accounts in line with schedules
- Ensure all documents are complete, accurate, and compliant before release
- Monitor and resolve any issues preventing successful billing release

Billing Performance Monitoring
- Run daily/weekly billing reports to track timeliness and completion
- Identify delayed or missed billing and investigate root causes

Data Accuracy & Quality

- Highlight inconsistencies or data issues and liaise with stakeholders to resolve

Key Skills & Experience
Essential

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Good Excel/reporting skills (e.g., filtering, lookups, data tracking)

Desirable
- Experience with billing or ERP systems
- Understanding of billing cycles /revenue processes
- Experience running performance or operational reports

Ideal Candidate Profile
- Highly organised and process-driven
- Comfortable working with data and reports
- Proactive in identifying and resolving issues
- Strong communicator across teams
